description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of epochs and the Word Error Rate (WER) for different fine-tuning methods of the Whisper model, specifically for the "tiny" type. The x-axis represents the epoch, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 6, and tick labels at every integer value. The y-axis represents the WER, also with a linear scale, ranging from 30 to 70, with tick labels at every 10 units. The plot displays five lines, each representing a different fine-tuning method: "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" (dark gray, circle markers, solid line), "tiny AdaLoRA_int8" (dark gray, square markers, dashed line), "tiny int4" (light gray, circle markers, solid line), "tiny int8" (light gray, square markers, dashed line), and "tiny" (light gray, triangle markers, dotted line). The "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" line starts at approximately 68 WER at epoch 0 and decreases to around 33 WER at epoch 6. The "tiny AdaLoRA_int8" line begins at about 59 WER at epoch 0 and ends at approximately 32 WER at epoch 6. The "tiny int4" line starts at around 67 WER at epoch 0 and decreases to about 36 WER at epoch 6. The "tiny int8" line begins at approximately 63 WER at epoch 0 and ends at around 34 WER at epoch 6. The "tiny" line remains relatively stable, starting at around 29 WER at epoch 0 and ending at approximately 25 WER at epoch 6. All lines exhibit a decreasing trend across the epochs, with varying rates of decline.
